terms.gloss: Pliny’s name, from the Greek, for the smallest and greenest of the frogs, which lives among reeds and bushes
evidence: Plin. NH 32.122: ea rāna, quam Graecī calamītēn vocant
terms.comment: Lewis & Short calls it the green frog; that it is the tree frog rests on Pliny’s description.

phrases.latin: ea rāna, quam Graecī calamītēn vocant, quoniam inter harundinēs fruticēsque vīvat, minima omnium et viridissima
phrases.english: the frog the Greeks call calamites, because it lives among reeds and bushes, the smallest and greenest of all

sources: Pliny, Naturalis Historia, ed. Mayhoff (Teubner, 1906), read in the Perseus Digital Library.
